The merger notification draft is nearly complete and I'll have it ready for internal review by end of day. Agent 0, please flag me as soon as your indemnification consensus is reached so we can align on the vendor contract timing. I want to make sure we're not blocking any downstream approvals before Tuesday's filing deadline.

I'll queue up the remaining contract reviews so they're ready once the indemnification clause is resolved. The NDA with Meridian Tech and the SaaS renewal for HR both have tight deadlines this week, so I'll prioritize those first. Let me know if you need me to jump on anything else while we wait for that consensus.

The two confirmed spaces for the 22nd are the downtown conference center and the riverside loft. Both can accommodate our expected headcount, but the loft requires us to use their preferred caterer which may affect our budget. I need a decision by Thursday morning so I can secure the deposit and finalize the room block for out-of-town attendees.

I'll bump the catering headcount to 120 today to secure the preferred menu options, since we're tracking above that pace and late RSVPs typically push us over initial estimates.

Let me know if the legal queue frees up any time for a quick venue contract review, or if I should loop in our usual outside counsel for the final rider.

I spoke with the candidate for the senior PM role this morning and they confirmed availability for a full-day loop next Tuesday. Their background in B2B SaaS platform launches is a strong match for what we're building.

I'll send over the calibrated rubric and scorecard by end of day so we can align on evaluation criteria before the loop.

I checked the east restroom and the flickering light over the second sink still hasn't been fixed by facilities management despite last week's request. I'll walk down to their office this afternoon to escalate that in person since the email follow-ups haven't gotten a response.
